name: @cevtuo/sync-trigger
description: Sync trigger + status. The ONLY place a token can be hidden — mini-program packages are decompilable and H5 JS is plaintext, so any credential in the client is public. Hosts /api/sync (trigger) and /api/status (freshness). Logic in src/core.ts is adapter-neutral; server.ts runs it on the Mac, worker.ts on Cloudflare.
